FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: TechSavvy Solutions provides comprehensive IT consulting and technology services, specializing in remote technical support, software development, network management, and cybersecurity solutions for small to medium-sized businesses. Our operations focus on delivering high-quality, tailored technology solutions while maintaining strict compliance with data protection regulations. We offer services such as cloud management, data backup and recovery, and online IT training, all designed to help clients enhance their operational efficiency and security posture. Our team operates primarily from a central office, minimizing on-site exposure, and we have robust policies in place to ensure data security and regulatory compliance.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: TechSavvy Innovations LLC, providing innovative software solutions and digital marketing services.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, TechSavvy Solutions experienced a data breach due to a phishing attack, resulting in unauthorized access to client data. The estimated loss incurred for notification and remediation was $3,200. The matter is currently resolved with no ongoing claims.

FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during business hours to monitor premises and prevent unauthorized access.
